memory.subject: Temperature excursion on load 5512
memory.incoming: Our receiver logged 9°C on arrival for load 5512. Product was supposed to stay at 2-4°C. What happened and what are you doing about it?
memory.reply:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for flagging this straight away. I've pulled the reefer log for load 5512: the unit alarmed at 06:40 and the driver reset it at 07:05, so the product sat above range for about 25 minutes. I've opened a claim with the carrier and put the trailer out of service until it's inspected.

Please hold the affected pallets; our QA lead will call you by 2pm today to agree on disposition, and we'll cover the cost of anything you reject.

Dana Ruiz
Operations Lead, Northwind Logistics

memory.subject: Invoice question INV-4302
memory.incoming: INV-4302 charges detention for 3 hours but our dock released the truck after 1 hour. Can you correct it?
memory.reply:
Hi Tom,

You're right to query it. Our gate log shows the truck checked out at 11:52, so detention should be 1 hour, not 3. I've asked finance to reissue INV-4302 with the corrected line; you'll have the credit note within two working days.

Sorry for the hassle.

Dana Ruiz
Operations Lead, Northwind Logistics

memory.subject: Rate request: Dallas to Atlanta
memory.incoming: Sharing our rates for the Dallas to Atlanta lane, valid 60 days. Let me know if you want to lock in volume.
memory.reply:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Before we commit volume, could you confirm two things: whether the rate includes fuel surcharge at today's index, and your on-time percentage on this lane for the last quarter? I'll compare against our current carrier and get back to you by Friday.

Dana Ruiz
Operations Lead, Northwind Logistics

emails.subject: URGENT: reefer unit failed on load 6120
emails.body:
Dana,

The driver on load 6120 just called our receiving desk: the reefer unit failed somewhere after Joliet and the trailer is reading 7°C. There are 22 pallets of dairy on board and our QA team will reject anything that's been above 5°C for more than two hours.

I need to know by 3pm today whether you can get a replacement trailer to the driver or whether we should arrange cross-docking at our Gary facility. Please call me if that's faster.

Priya Nair
Logistics Manager, Harbor Fresh Foods

Tom Becker
Accounts Payable, Alder & Finch Retail
